:::{#thm-ar1-stationary}
#### Stationary distribution of the autoregressive chain

For the chain of @exm-ar1-chain with $\abs{\arcoef} < 1$,
the normal distribution with mean 0 and variance $\sigma^2 / (1 - \arcoef^2)$
is a [stationary distribution](#def-stationary-distribution):

$$
\ndist{0, \frac{\sigma^2}{1 - \arcoef^2}}.
$$ {#eq-ar1-stationary}

:::

::: proof

This result is the solution to @exr-ar1-stationary.

:::
